decision_conditions: <p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span style="font-size:12pt;">The proposed gates, by reason of their solid appearance and inappropriate suburban design would appear as an incongruous and visually obtrusive addition to the street scene, which would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the South Hill Avenue Conservation Area and the Area of Special Character and there is not clear and convincing justification for the harm, nor public benefits to outweigh them. Therefore the development is harmful to the character and appearance of the area and contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies&nbsp;HC1.C and D3.D(1) and D3.D(11) of The London Plan (2021), Policy&nbsp;CS1.B and D of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policies DM1, DM6 and DM7 of the Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: South Hill Avenue Conservation Area Appraisal and Management Strategy (2008) and the Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style=""><span style="font-size:12pt;">The proposed two storey rear extension, by reason of excessive bulk and massing and large crown roof, would form an incongruous, discordant, unduly bulky and dominant addition to the host dwelling which would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the South Hill Avenue Conservation Area,&nbsp;and the Area of Special Character and there is not clear and convincing justification for the harm, nor public benefits to outweigh them.&nbsp;The development is therefore contrary to the high quality design aspirations of National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3.D(1) and D3.D(11) and HC1 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.B and D of The Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policies DM1, DM6 and DM7 of Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013); the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: South Hill Avenue Conservation Area Appraisal and Management Strategy (2008) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).&nbsp; &nbsp;</span></p>
description: Conversion of garage to habitable room, Replacement garage doors in front elevation, Two storey side to rear extension, Rear dormers, Juliette balcony to first floor rear elevation, External alterations,  1.2m timber gate to front
